notes.title: Torn Veil Release hot fix
notes.content:
Huge thank you for those who downloaded and played the game!

With the release going forward I will read and try to fix and improve the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed ending Dialogue triggering twice.
[*] Fixed mouse sensitivity not being applied properly.
[*] Fixed garage letter and widget mismatch.
[/list]

These bugs are fixed now and many smaller ones. If you encounter bugs you may talk about it in the discussion of the game as I am actively reading them. 

Thank you all again.

-KenshiDev

notes.title: Torn Veil is out! - PLAY NOW with 3 available endings
notes.content:
[h3][b]The veil has been torn… and there's no going back.[/b][/h3][h3][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491595/5e937d2f532bda2fef06ba56979e9e80c6e599c8.png"][/img][/h3][p]After months of development, fear, and mystery — [b]Torn Veil[/b] is officially live on Steam.[/p][p]🕯️ [b]Enter a twisted house where souls are tested, memories are fractured, and nothing stays dead for long.[/b]
Explore a haunting house that seems to remember you. Uncover what happened to the scientists behind the soul experiment, and survive the presence that lurks behind every corner.[/p][p]🔪 [b]Features[/b]
– A story-driven psychological horror experience
– Puzzles, hidden lore, and twisted AI entities
– Arabic and English support
– Designed by a solo Iraqi developer[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who supported, wishlisted, tested, or even just cheered silently from the shadows.
Now it’s your turn to uncover the truth beneath the veil.[/p][p][b]Play it. Survive it. Remember it.[/b]
— [i]KenshiDev[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🕯️ Torn Veil Launches July 29, 2025 🕯️
notes.content:
[p][b]Prepare to enter the house. Some doors were never meant to open.[/b][/p][p]I am thrilled to finally announce that [b]Torn Veil[/b], our psychological horror game steeped in mystery, soul experiments, and spectral whispers, will officially launch on [b]July 29, 2025[/b].[/p][p]You’ve read the diaries. You’ve heard the radio show. Now it’s your turn to [b]step inside[/b].[/p][h3]What to Expect:[/h3][list][*][p]A haunting narrative driven by forgotten experiments and fractured memories[/p][/*][*][p]Lore-rich environments, from crooked rooms to soul-bound machines[/p][/*][*][p]Reactive puzzles and chilling encounters inspired by classic survival horror[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple endings based on your choices... and your awareness[/p][/*][/list][h3]Can you uncover the truth behind the Vorne family and the Crooked Soul?[/h3][p]We’ll be sharing more in the coming days including localization details, final gameplay trailer, and special shoutouts to our amazing early playtesters.
📻 Until then, keep your radios tuned. Nightline Frequency is still broadcasting.[/p][p][b]Wishlist, share, and prepare your nerves.[/b]
The veil tears on [b]July 29[/b].[/p][p]—
[i]“No more machines. No blood to pour.”[/i][/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Torn veil Demo
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that the demo for Torn Veil is now live!
This is your chance to step into the haunting world we’ve been building and experience the first chapter of the story.
🧪 Explore the mysterious ground floor
🕵️ Discover early clues about the Torn Veil Project
👁️ Get a feel for the eerie atmosphere, puzzles, and tone
Your feedback will help shape the full release — so dive in, explore, and let us know what you think!
